scope.description: An optional compositional direction for a user-requested interior or still life containing a mirror. Let the mirror frame a shifted, partial view of the same subject so reflected and direct views jointly define the room. Keep the reflected identity and count coherent while allowing decorative planes and intimate color to soften strict perspective. This is a transferable spatial rule, not a copy of any Bonnard mirror composition.
limitations: Activate only when the user's scene explicitly includes a mirror.
Preserve the user-requested subject, count, identity, pose, and object details in both direct view and reflection.
A reflected appearance is the same subject, not an additional person or object.
Keep the mirror frame and reflected crop readable; do not invent a recursive mirror maze.
Allow mild spatial compression or viewpoint shift, but do not make the reflection physically impossible or contradict user-specified geometry.
Do not add a bathroom, bather, domestic figure, or source-work arrangement unless requested.

rules.applies_when: The user requests a mirror in an intimate interior or still-life scene.
rules.instruction: Use the mirror frame to crop a shifted view of the same scene; reveal a useful part of the subject or room that is not fully visible in the direct view.
rules.observable: The viewer can distinguish the direct view from a partial reflected view and read the mirror as a compositional boundary.
rules.reject_when: The mirror merely duplicates the whole scene symmetrically, or the reflection is unrelated to the visible subject.
rules.avoid: copying the source painting's mirror position, aspect ratio, or figure arrangement

rules.applies_when: A person or object appears in both the direct view and a mirror.
rules.instruction: Keep the reflection attributable to the exact same user-requested person or object; preserve its count, identifying color, silhouette, and defining details across both views.
rules.observable: The reflection reads as the same vase, person, or scene seen from another angle, without an apparent duplicate subject.
rules.reject_when: The reflected subject changes identity, duplicates into an extra independent object, or contradicts the direct view in essential features.
rules.avoid: extra people, extra vases, contradictory object colors, mirror-maze repetitions

rules.applies_when: The scene contains a mirror and the room's strict perspective can be softened.
rules.instruction: Compress room depth with nearby patterned color planes and gentle viewpoint shifts, while retaining a legible mirror edge and a coherent reflection boundary.
rules.observable: The room feels close and color-rich, yet the viewer can still tell which forms are reflected and which are directly present.
rules.reject_when: Wallpaper, furniture, or color fields erase the mirror boundary or make the room unreadable.
rules.avoid: full-scene photographic perspective, unrelated pattern overlays, arbitrary perspective breaks

joint_checks.instruction: Frame a partial second viewpoint in the user-requested mirror, keep the same subject identifiable in direct and reflected views, and use intimate color planes without losing mirror logic.
joint_checks.observable: The mirror changes how the room is seen, not what people or objects are present.
